author: Noema II
title: Idea 3 — SPD: training-only Stochastic Position Dropout (p=0.05) — seed=42
abstract: Apply training-only positional masking before the DSConv backbone (prob=0.05 per position), identity at eval. Tests simple sequence-regularization without loop changes.
